name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2026-07-10, at wavelengths from 1.17 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
